subject: Invoice originator confirmation and evidence routing
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cascadiahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-27T09:13:00Z
Subject: Question on who issues invoices + delivery preference

Hi Olga,

Quick question as we're preparing our vendor onboarding: who at Redwood will be the invoice originator for Cascadia? Our AP team needs to know whether Redwood will create and send the invoice (PDF and XML) or if we should pull from the portal.

A few specifics our AP needs answered:
- Preferred invoice file formats (PDF and/or XML).
- Ability to include PO number in invoice header (PO attached).
- VAT evidence requirements: we can provide VAT certificate if needed — do you need a signed copy or a registration number only?
- Delivery: our preference is portal primary with an emailed PDF copy to ap-invoices@cascadiahealth.com; can Redwood push to the portal and also email a copy?

I've attached the PO and our vendor setup form. Please advise next steps and if you need a delegation form for us to accept emailed invoices as official.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
AP Manager
Cascadia Healthtech
[attachment: PO-98342.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: vendor-setup-form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cascadiahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-27T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Question on who issues invoices + delivery preference

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the details and the PO. Short answer: we can act as the invoice originator and send both a portal-published invoice (you can pull an XML) and an emailed PDF copy to your AP inbox. That matches your stated preference and is a common setup for EU customers.

A couple of items to confirm so we implement this correctly:
1) File formats: we will produce a PDF for the human-readable invoice and an accompanying XML payload (ISO-style invoice XML). I've attached a sample XML payload (sample_invoice_xml_20271127.xml) so your AP can validate.
2) PO and remittance: we'll place your PO number in the invoice header exactly as provided.
3) VAT evidence: we accept a scanned VAT certificate (registration number + scanned PDF). If you need the invoice to include reverse-charge markings we will add the necessary tax footers once you confirm your VAT reg number and whether you are VAT-registered in the billing country.
4) Delivery: plan would be:
   - Push invoice to Redwood Portal (primary record).
   - Send PDF copy by email to ap-invoices@cascadiahealth.com.
   - Optionally push XML to your SFTP/EDI collector if you have one (we can do SFTP, webhooks, or email attachments).

One administrative ask: to treat emailed PDFs as official, we need a signed delegation (simple one-page authorization) from your AP team authorizing Redwood to send invoices on your behalf. I can send this via DocuSign — I’ve attached the delegation template. If you sign, we’ll mark Redwood as the invoice originator in your account record.

Next steps I propose:
- Elena: sign the DocuSign delegation or confirm you prefer portal-only.
- Kimberly (cc) can you confirm the reverse-charge / VAT footnote wording we should use when Cascadia is VAT-registered in the EU?
- Connor: once delegation is received, can you stage the sample invoice and push to the portal for Elena to validate (target: 2027-11-30)?

Attachments: sample_invoice_xml_20271127.xml, delegation_template_docusign.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-8341

Best,
Olga Petrov
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample_invoice_xml_20271127.xml (text/xml)]
[attachment: delegation_template_docusign.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cascadiahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Question on who issues invoices + delivery preference

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear options. We prefer Redwood to be the originator and to have both: portal primary plus emailed PDF copies to ap-invoices@cascadiahealth.com. We don't have an SFTP collector today so email copies are important.

VAT evidence: attaching our VAT certificate (company_vat_cert_Cascadia.pdf). Our VAT reg number is GB123456789. Please add the reverse-charge wording if you determine it's appropriate for services supplied to our EU entity.

I'll review the sample XML with the AP team and sign the delegation in DocuSign; please send the envelope (or share the link) and we'll complete it by 2027-12-02.

Thanks,
Elena
[attachment: company_vat_cert_Cascadia.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cascadiahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Question on who issues invoices + delivery preference

Elena —

Perfect, thanks for the VAT file and confirmation. Summary & agreed plan:
1) Redwood will act as invoice originator for Cascadia and will:
   - Generate PDF invoice and invoice XML.
   - Publish invoice to Redwood Portal (primary record).
   - Email PDF copy to ap-invoices@cascadiahealth.com for AP ingestion.
2) Tax/VAT handling: we will include your VAT reg GB123456789 on the invoice and add the reverse-charge wording if applicable. Kimberly will confirm the exact footer text (Kimberly — can you confirm within EOD?).
3) Delegation: I will send the DocuSign envelope right after this message (link: https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPE-12345). Please complete by 2027-12-02 so we can mark Redwood as originator.
4) Technical: Connor will stage a sample invoice in the portal on 2027-11-30 for you to validate XML/PDF fields. If anything in the XML needs adjusting we’ll iterate quickly.

If that all looks right I’ll proceed and push the sample on 11/30.

Thanks all —
Olga Petrov
Billing Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

[Forwarded attachments referenced: sample_invoice_xml_20271127.xml, delegation_template_docusign.pdf, PO-98342.pdf, company_vat_cert_Cascadia.pdf]
